title: CTO & VP Engineering | ContextMint
description: Leadership view of ContextMint v1.0 — decision-control in the IDE, regulated pilot path, honest roadmap for scorecards and PR verification.

hero.title: Govern AI velocity with evidence gates
hero.leadAfter: a local AI coding assistant for the team — Ask, Plan, and Agent, Context Lens, and human approval before writes. Board scorecards and PR-time verification stay on the roadmap.

cards.title: What you can pilot now
cards.text: Evidence-based chat with citations, store-first governance lookup, patch preview, and optional shared on-prem server with OIDC for regulated pilots.

cards.title: What stays on the roadmap
cards.text: Engineering scorecards for QBRs, DNA adoption dashboards, blast-radius SKU, and firm-wide ownership reconciliation — after v1.0 gates pass.

checklist: Human Gates 1 & 2 in VS Code — evidence before inference and apply
Quality map findings with apply review (not autonomous fix)
Local-first default; sovereign shared-server path for regulated pilots
Clear separation of v1.0 vs Verification Engine roadmap in external copy
